messages:
Jordan: quick update: moving start +2m to let video team finish upload. roadmap Q&A will be after demos; please drop async questions here or in the doc. recording ON.
Tam: noted. will trim my slides to 4m so we don't run over.
Rui: can we confirm the backup stream key? last all-hands lost stream for ~1m.
StreamBot: Preflight OK. primary stream_key valid. backup_key present. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769023333.mp4
Hannah: captions please double-check. we had lag on captions in the APAC region last time.
OpsBot: Captions: enabled. Edge health: us-west-2 99.99, eu-west-1 99.97, apac-1 99.94. Watching for TTL lag.
VideoBot: OBS scene 'All-hands' loaded. Studio link ready: https://studio.redwood/all-hands/1769023333.
Jordan: @DevEx can you remind presenters to mute desktop audio and only use mic channel? duplicates happen when desktop audio is on.
DevEx: will ping presenters with checklist now.
Tam: mic check in 2: "Redwood check one two"
Rui: done. heard OK on preview.
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 6 (pre).
Hannah: stream preview shows 4s caption delay in my local preview. Ops, is that expected?
OpsBot: short caption propagation to edge apac-1 ~4s. global audience should be ~1-2s. monitoring.
Tam: noticed small audio echo on the preview, sounds like remote participant unmuted.
Jordan: we'll mute remote guests for their segments. @DevEx keep a hand on mute toggles.
VideoBot: dropped frames detected at 10:12:03 (0.05%). adjusting keyframe interval.
Rui: is there a way to stamp the recording where the drop occurred so editor doesn't hunt?
VideoBot: placing marker at 10:12:03.
Jordan: if the drop exceeds 1% for 30s, failover to backup ingest.
OpsBot: failover policy armed. will switch after sustained 30s >1% drop. notify on-call.
Hannah: demo started. screen share audio seems low for the mobile demo audience.
Tam: I can boost mic gain slightly for demo handoff.
DevEx: noted. adding raw + mixed audio export to upload checklist.
StreamBot: Live viewers: 220. Reaction: :clap:.
Rui: chat question for leadership: will dedicated clusters allow soft quotas per-team?
Jordan: short yes, details in roadmap doc next week; we'll follow up in the Q&A doc.
Hannah: caption gap at 10:22:11-10:22:16 for a sub-clip. VideoBot marked segment.
VideoBot: captions restarted via fallback at 10:22:18.
Jordan: keep going, we'll annotate the recording and publish corrected transcript after postprocessing.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. File uploaded: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769023333.mp4.
OpsBot: Transcode complete. 1080p and captions available at https://files.redwood/recordings/1769023333. Checksums good.
DevEx: thanks y'all. i'll post the slides + async Q&A link in #general and add edit markers to the editor ticket.
Jordan: awesome. retro on stream ops tomorrow at 11am; please add action items to the board.
